risks.observed: Read/seek retry when output empty but decoded remaining nonzero even after nonzero inflate status.
risks.consequence: Persistent zero source reads, truncated/corrupt input, early stream end or size mismatch can loop indefinitely.

risks.observed: No zero-init before source read, no actual<=request/capacity check, return value ignored.
risks.consequence: Failing source that does not report actual count can cause invalid pointer and count arithmetic.

risks.observed: Output capacity always65536; not bounded by declared remaining; subtract uint32 produced delta.
risks.consequence: Declared decoded size smaller than output can underflow remaining count.

risks.observed: Refill does not retain zlib status and publishes a partial prefix even after error.
risks.consequence: Native cannot distinguish declared EOF, stream completion and error through read return; prefix may be delivered before hang.
